description: NEXTN verify steps of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next on one MI355X: 1 to 8 requests of 4 verify tokens (the CUDA-graph batch sizes the monokernel serves) over contexts of 2k to 128k tokens. Short contexts (up to 2048 tokens) attend to every block; longer ones select 512 of up to 32768 blocks, in up to 4 index segments of 8192. Correctness-only cases cover the minimum context, odd request counts and contexts that are not a multiple of 4, 16 or 64.

cases.source: minimum: one request just past its prompt
five requests, contexts not a multiple of 4
three requests, top-512 over two index segments
single request, 32k context (one full index segment)
eight requests (32 rows, the largest graph batch), 2k context
